description: Déploiement de la fibre à Cachan is a dataset listed in Cachan open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Orange. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Déploiement de la fibre à Cachan Adresses raccordées à la Fibre et commercialisables. Source: Orange Mise à jour le 29-09-2020 La "vue personnalisée" a été conçue avec les données Orange et les données de l'ARCEP:. Coverage: Cachan. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are fibre, numerique, Accès au numérique, Au quotidien. The portal shows 3,154 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cachan-portal.
